msg: The colours of the gnomes will be as follows; Blue,Brown,Pink,PurpleYou will need to pair the gnomes into the following groups(Blue/Brown)(Pink/Purple)1. Select a gnome to start with e.g. pink2. If that gnome gives you mushrooms of 3 or higher, on the next gnome select either pink or purple3. Keep going with this combination until the amount of mushroom recieved is 2 or less4. Once 2 or less, then select the other group of coloured gnomes e.g. green/blue5. Repeat these steps to get the max amount of mushrooms
